If the background worker (`PayloadGeneratorWorker`) fails or if the detected file type doesn't match known patterns in `PayloadGenerator.FILE_TYPE_PATTERNS` (Line 23), no payloads are added to the table.

The autonomous functionality is split into basic operations and advanced autonomy.
